```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(yaml)

# ---- Category + emoji mapping (11 groups) ----

CATEGORIES <- list(
  "Package Dev" = list(
    icon = "📦",
    prefixes = c("r-init-package", "r-pkg-add-", "r-pkg-check", "r-pkg-release",
                 "r-pkgcheck-", "r-pkgdown-", "r-pak-")
  ),
  "Testing & QA" = list(
    icon = "🧪",
    prefixes = c("r-lint", "r-tdd-", "r-bdd-", "r-testthat-", "r-code-review")
  ),
  "Shiny Apps" = list(
    icon = "✨",
    prefixes = c("r-init-shiny", "r-shiny-module", "r-shiny-theme-", "r-shiny-e2e-", "r-rhino-")
  ),
  "Data Pipelines" = list(
    icon = "🎯",
    prefixes = c("r-init-targets", "r-targets-")
  ),
  "Deploy & DevOps" = list(
    icon = "🚀",
    prefixes = c("r-docker-", "r-connect-", "r-vetiver-", "r-ci-")
  ),
  "APIs" = list(
    icon = "🔌",
    prefixes = c("r-api-", "r-init-plumber")
  ),
  "Observability" = list(
    icon = "📊",
    prefixes = c("r-logger-", "r-otel-", "r-profile")
  ),
  "Data & Validation" = list(
    icon = "🛡️",
    prefixes = c("r-data-", "r-pointblank-")
  ),
  "Architecture" = list(
    icon = "🏗️",
    prefixes = c("r-box-", "r-s7-", "r-refactor", "r-async-")
  ),
  "Config & Security" = list(
    icon = "🔒",
    prefixes = c("r-config-", "r-security")
  ),
  "Reports" = list(
    icon = "📄",
    prefixes = c("r-quarto-")
  )
)

get_playbook_meta <- function(name) {
  for (cat_name in names(CATEGORIES)) {
    for (prefix in CATEGORIES[[cat_name]]$prefixes) {
      if (startsWith(name, prefix)) {
        return(c(CATEGORIES[[cat_name]]$icon, cat_name))
      }
    }
  }
  c("📋", "Other")
}

# ---- Read all playbooks ----

playbook_dirs <- list.dirs("playbooks", recursive = FALSE)
playbooks <- list()

for (dir in playbook_dirs) {
  md_file <- file.path(dir, "PLAYBOOK.md")
  if (!file.exists(md_file)) next

  content <- readLines(md_file, warn = FALSE)
  dashes <- which(content == "---")
  if (length(dashes) < 2) next

  yaml_text <- paste(content[(dashes[1] + 1):(dashes[2] - 1)], collapse = "\n")
  meta <- tryCatch(yaml.load(yaml_text), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(meta)) next

  m <- get_playbook_meta(meta$name)

  playbooks[[length(playbooks) + 1]] <- list(
    name     = meta$name,
    desc     = meta$description %||% "",
    version  = meta$version %||% "1.0.0",
    trigger  = meta$trigger %||% "manual",
    dir      = basename(dir),
    icon     = m[1],
    category = m[2],
    gh_url   = sprintf("https://github.com/davidrsch/r-playbooks/blob/main/playbooks/%s/PLAYBOOK.md", basename(dir))
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
n_total   <- length(playbooks)
cats      <- sort(table(sapply(playbooks, `[[`, "category")), decreasing = TRUE)
init_show <- 12
```

::: {.playbook-grid id="playbook-grid"}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

cards <- character(length(playbooks))
for (i in seq_along(playbooks)) {
  pb <- playbooks[[i]]
  trigger_class <- if (pb$trigger == "both") "both" else "manual"
  trigger_label <- toupper(pb$trigger)
  hidden <- if (i > init_show) ' style="display:none"' else ""

  cards[i] <- sprintf(
    '<div class="playbook-card%s" data-name="%s" data-category="%s" style="--card-accent: var(--bs-primary);"><label class="card-check"><input type="checkbox" class="card-checkbox" data-file="%s" data-name="%s" title="Select this playbook"></label><a href="%s" class="card-body"><div class="card-header"><span class="card-icon">%s</span><span class="card-name">%s</span></div><div class="card-description">%s</div><div class="card-meta"><span class="badge badge-version">v%s</span><span class="badge badge-trigger %s">%s</span><span class="badge badge-link">📋 source</span></div></a></div>',
    hidden, pb$name, pb$category,
    pb$dir, pb$name,
    pb$gh_url,
    pb$icon, pb$name,
    pb$desc,
    pb$version, trigger_class, trigger_label
  )
}

knitr::asis_output(paste(cards, collapse = "\n"))
```
